scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/catalogue packages/composition-model packages/agents packages/models packages/engine && tsc -p apps/service --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop --noEmit && tsc -p apps/ui --noEmit
scripts.build:all: tsc -b packages/engine packages/models && npm run build -w @expertmotion/service && npm run build -w @expertmotion/ui && npm run fonts -w @expertmotion/engine && npm run build:bundle -w @expertmotion/engine && node packages/engine/scripts/build-sample.mjs && npm run build:main -w @expertmotion/desktop
scripts.release:win: npm run build:all && npm run stage:desktop && npm run harden -w @expertmotion/desktop && npm run pack:win -w @expertmotion/desktop
